name: blackjack
author: ItzDevoo Dev
description: Multiplayer BlackJack for friends and families: sit at a table, bet fake CP against an automatic dealer, and climb the server leaderboard.

settings.label: Starting CP
settings.description: How much CP a player receives the first time they open BlackJack.

settings.label: Daily bonus CP
settings.description: CP a player can claim once a day to keep playing. Set to 0 to disable.

settings.label: Decks in the shoe
settings.description: Number of 52-card decks shuffled together. The shoe reshuffles after about three quarters are dealt.

settings.label: Betting window (seconds)
settings.description: How long players have to place bets once the first chip goes down.

settings.label: Turn timer (seconds)
settings.description: How long a player has to act on a hand before they automatically stand.

settings.label: Dealer hits soft 17
settings.description: On: the dealer draws on soft 17 (slightly favours the house). Off: the dealer stands on all 17s.

settings.label: Members can open tables
settings.description: When off, only moderators can open new tables.

settings.label: Max open tables
settings.description: Upper limit on tables open at once, including the main table.
